input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use: (i) the Software, safely in executable object code format, at each AS400 at each of the Authorized Locations; and (ii) the Documentation.
input.rationale: The grant is perpetual so long as fees are paid (§17(a)) and even converts to a fee-free perpetual licence on Garman default (p0128), so it is not revocable at will and is nowhere near walk-away. It also already covers Sparkling's affiliated companies without any notice condition, which exceeds the fallback on that element. However it fails the fallback's other material term: the licence is expressly "non-transferable", §3(c) bars assignment or sublicence without Garman's written consent, and §20(d) requires consent for any assignment, so there is no path to transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction; contractors acting on our behalf are also excluded. We therefore made the minimal edits to reach the preferred position — adding contractors acting on our behalf to the permitted users and a consent-free transfer right to a successor in a merger, acquisition or asset sale, with a conforming carve-out in the use restrictions.

proposal.summary: Extend grant to contractors acting on our behalf and permit transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the licence to contractors acting on our behalf and added a right to transfer the licence to a successor in a merger, acquisition or asset sale, consistent with our position that licences must cover our operational users and survive corporate transactions. Affiliate coverage in the existing grant is acceptable as drafted.

ops.oldText: for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use
ops.newText: for the use of Sparkling, affiliated companies of Sparkling and contractors acting on Sparkling's behalf, in each case at the Authorized Locations, a non-exclusive licence, transferable to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of Sparkling's assets, to use

ops.oldText: except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;
ops.newText: except as permitted by Section 2 or Section 20(d) or as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;

ops.oldText: without the written consent of the other party.
ops.newText: without the written consent of the other party, except that either party may assign this Agreement to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets without such consent.
